svg.title: Occasional third-party skill maintenance
svg.desc: Renovate owns one update PR. A trusted helper is intended to regenerate skills and lock in that PR, then validate on the regenerated head and request human review. Hosted helper and required-check behavior are unverified.
svg.text: Hosted helper / CI association UNVERIFIED — authorized dry run required.
Renovate updates the allowlisted source declaration; CLI pinned at 1.7.4.
2 Materialize generated outputs in the same PR
Trusted helper: narrow outputs, isolated install, exact-head writeback.
3 Validate content and required checks on the regenerated SHA
Reject stale locks/content. Token pushes alone do not prove CI retriggering.
4 Human review before merge — no instruction automerge
Upstream bodies unchanged; repo integration separate; OpenSpec untouched.
Policy and blockers: docs/agents/integration.md. Per-change delivery: DEVELOPMENT-PROCESS.svg.
